editable_host_changes.change: Last item of the Choice assumption map now points to the reconstruction of both Shelah's and Keisler's hypotheses. Shelah paragraph (lines 30-48) keeps lambda, mu, single D and no GCH; the sentence giving Keisler's version 'as Shelah reports it' is removed. New paragraph (lines 50-79) rebuilds Keisler 1961's hypotheses from the held article: AC with well-ordering and maximal principles (p. 479); alpha >= omega, alpha >= number of predicate symbols, kappa(2^alpha) = alpha^+; index set of cardinality alpha; factors of cardinality <= kappa(2^alpha); two ultrafilters D, E containing bar S_alpha(I), built after the structures (pp. 484-486); ultrapower case on alpha (p. 486); existential form under GCH (p. 487); single fixed ultrafilter only in the announced appendix results (pp. 490-492), which Shelah's summary matches; the Choice used in Keisler's proof. It \cref's sec:p03-w03-p03-018-keisler.
